description: This file defines the React component 'NoteGroupView', which manages and renders views related to notes and files within a web application. It handles displaying multiple selected notes/files and individual note/file views, utilizing various controllers and managing state tied to the selection and pane views.

classes.name: NoteGroupView
classes.description: A React component managing and displaying grouped note and file views, including handling multiple selection states and individual item views.

methods.description: Initializes the component with props and sets up initial state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up observers and autorun functions to manage component state based on application state changes.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes observers and performs cleanup when component is unmounted.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the JSX elements based on current component state, including multiple notes/files view or individual note/file views.
